purpose: Pre-registration for the single-cell G4 validation of the two currently testable ICLR hero claims (sparse Arm-A top1 production speed; learned top2 conditional compute). Frozen before the G4 run; the harness verifies these fingerprints and thresholds at runtime.
repo_commit_note: Candidate systems freeze 0dcbb87; harness/contract/cell pin is this commit (contract_commit). The harness records the actual HEAD at run time; the candidate blobs below are identical at 734d622, 0dcbb87 and this commit.

candidate_blob_audit.result: ALL benchmark-relevant blobs are byte-identical between the two commits (git rev-parse of each path): opt/model_ref.py, opt/model_opt.py, opt/scan_attn.py, opt/routed_expert.py, opt/learned_router.py, opt/expert_moe.py, opt/onehour_microbatch.py, opt/bench_expert_moe.py, training/arm_a_2p5b_trainer.py, context/frozen_corpus_contract.json
candidate_blob_audit.interpretation: 0dcbb87 only adds provenance scripts (opt/onehour_b3_cache.py, opt/onehour_b4_writer.py, opt/onehour_reprofile.py) and results; the B3 gather-cache experiment was killed and reverted, so the frozen STACK0 candidate implementation is exactly the implementation pinned by these fingerprints.
candidate_blob_audit.note: Never depend on the live dirty tree; the harness verifies the committed blobs.

harness.hash_mode: sha256 of text content with CRLF normalized to LF
harness.selftest: SELFTEST_PASS=true locally (CPU/tiny, torch 2.10.0+cpu, py3.12): model construction for dense/routed/learned, tiny fwd+bwd finite grads for all arms, learned route R0-R6 gates, unselected-expert zero-grad gate, straight-through proxy, update-glue bitwise-equal to opt.model_ref.full_update, report/verdict logic

fingerprint_semantics: Each fingerprint is the CRLF-normalized SHA-256 of the git blob at repo_commit, i.e. the exact implementation that produced the cited local evidence. The working tree may contain another agent's in-flight edits; the harness fails closed on any mismatch. Check out the pinned commit (or copy those exact file versions) before the G4 run. These candidates must not change without regenerating the contract, because the hero claims are tied to this revision.

selected_hero_claims.claim: Sparse Arm-A top1 (M8/Ke512, fixed cyclic window, G=128, exact capacity, compiled production stack) reaches >=350,000 packed input tokens/s at global batch 64 x T2048 on G4, with the speedup measured against the fresh same-session dense production measurement (CURRENT_G4_SAME_SESSION_DENSE) over the same frozen-corpus sequence range.
selected_hero_claims.falsified_if: best sparse packed tok/s < 350,000, or any hard correctness gate fails, or the dense/session controls drift beyond 5%
selected_hero_claims.does_not_claim: It is not dense Arm-A. The executor is exact relative to the declared sparse architecture; all-active expertized execution recovers dense Arm-A. No 2.5B training run is executed. Historical dense anchors are not used as the denominator.
selected_hero_claims.evidence_grade_on_pass: MEASURED (direct G4); 2.5B runtime projection is INFERRED; training/quality consequences are SPECULATIVE

selected_hero_claims.claim: Learned top2 hard routing (M8/Ke512 learned cyclic window, straight-through proxy, inactive experts physically skipped) preserves the near-zero routing overhead observed locally (<=5% vs fixed top2, local 0.0%) while retaining a large dense speedup at the matched B16x4 geometry, against the same-session dense measurement.
selected_hero_claims.falsified_if: router_overhead > 15% or learned speedup vs dense < 1.5x
selected_hero_claims.evidence_grade_on_pass: MEASURED (direct G4); Hero 2 is not optimized for the absolute speed record

benchmark_protocol.canonical_cell: campaigns/G4_HERO_CLAIM_CELL.md (ONE human-run G4 experiment). It supersedes results/g4_sparse_350k_cell.py, which is retained as provenance and must not be run alongside it.
benchmark_protocol.session: one G4 Colab session, one process per config (compile-contamination rule), fresh model and fresh compile per config
benchmark_protocol.speedup_denominator: CURRENT_G4_SAME_SESSION_DENSE only; historical anchors are provenance
benchmark_protocol.randomized_order: probe set {dense B16, sparse_top1 B8, sparse_top1 B16, sparse_top1 B32} shuffled with recorded seed; adaptive extras, Hero-2 pair, drift control and OOM census appended deterministically
benchmark_protocol.cold_start: fresh runtime; no torch import in the cell before the harness subprocess
benchmark_protocol.microbatch_geometries: B4x16, B8x8, B16x4, B32x2, B64x1 (global 64 sequences)
benchmark_protocol.adaptive_rule: probe B8/B16/B32; run B64 if B32 is best; run B4 if B8 is best
benchmark_protocol.timing: CUDA-synchronized wall time around a complete update: H2D input transfer, on-device mask build, forward, CE (valid targets only), backward, grad clip, fused AdamW step; median and p10/p90
benchmark_protocol.lr_schedule: certified warmup (peak 1e-3, 10M tokens), identical for all arms
benchmark_protocol.corpus_verification: FROZEN.json + corpus_manifest.json + artifact_hashes.json digests and all shard file sizes (fast_verify=True skips per-shard SHA-256); fail closed on mismatch
benchmark_protocol.corpus_usage: 13 distinct 64-row packed batches per config (3 warmups + 10 measured), starting at sequence 0; no replay; cross-sequence lookahead targets and masked padding as produced by training/FrozenPackedCorpus
benchmark_protocol.quality_gates: CPU tiny fp64/fp32 oracles (all-active equivalence, sparse semantics oracle, document-boundary leak, unselected-expert zero grad, learned R0-R6); GPU production-shape all-active equivalence fp32/bf16 (logits, loss, mapped gradients); graph-break counts for dense/top1/top2/learned; repeated-forward determinism; packed boundary no-leak at production T; corpus contract probe
benchmark_protocol.abort_policy: environment, repo fingerprints and corpus contract hard-fail; correctness gates hard-fail and skip benchmarks; graph/determinism recorded
benchmark_protocol.session_stability: dense B16 drift control in a fresh process after all candidates; |drift| > 5% marks the session unstable and blocks FINAL_G4_VALIDATION_PASS

expected_thresholds.final_pass_rule: all hard gates pass AND (HERO_1 PASS or HERO_2 PASS) AND session stable

verdict_lines_emitted_by_the_cell: legacy-compatible: G4_DENSE_TOK_S_B16, G4_SPARSE_TOK_S_B<geom>, G4_BEST_GEOMETRY, G4_PROJECTED_2P5B_HOURS, G4_RESULT_JSON

evidence_labels.MEASURED: direct G4 result produced by the cell
evidence_labels.INFERRED: 2.5B runtime projection from measured full-update throughput; no 2.5B run executed
evidence_labels.SPECULATIVE: expected training/quality consequences; not part of this contract

contract_maintenance: If any fingerprinted file changes, regenerate this contract (harness_sha256 and fingerprints) before the G4 run; the harness fails closed otherwise.
